description:
**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api).

Register an OIDC issuer that Anthropic will trust for workload identity
federation in your organization.

The `jwks` field controls how the issuer's signing keys are obtained and
takes one of three shapes selected by `type`: `discovery` (resolve keys
through OIDC discovery), `explicit_url` (fetch keys from a fixed JWKS
URL), or `inline` (provide a static key set). When `jwks.type` is
`discovery` and no `discovery_base` is set, the issuer URL must be
publicly reachable over HTTPS so Anthropic can fetch the discovery
document; for `explicit_url` and `inline` modes the issuer URL is only
matched as the JWT's `iss` claim and is not fetched.

404.description: Not found - Some requested entity was not found

408.description: Deadline exceeded - The deadline expired before the operation could complete

AnthropicBeta.description:
Beta names you can send in the `anthropic-beta` header.

See [Beta headers](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) for how to send them and where to find the name a feature needs.

check_jti.description: Whether the jwt-bearer exchange enforces JTI single-use (replay protection) for tokens from this issuer. Defaults to true. Applies only to assertions carrying a `jti` claim; tokens without one are accepted without single-use enforcement.
check_jti.title: Check Jti

issuer_url.description: The `iss` claim value to match against.
issuer_url.title: Issuer Url

jwks.description: How signing keys are obtained. Defaults to OIDC discovery.
jwks.title: Jwks

max_jwt_lifetime_seconds.description: Maximum allowed iat→exp spread for assertions from this issuer (1-176400 seconds, i.e. up to 49h). Defaults to 3600 (1h). Assertions must carry both `iat` and `exp`; a missing `iat` is rejected.
max_jwt_lifetime_seconds.title: Max Jwt Lifetime Seconds

name.description: Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409.
name.title: Name

BetaFederationIssuer.description:
Registered external OIDC identity provider.

Records an external IdP the organization trusts for the RFC 7523
jwt-bearer grant. The `issuer_url` must match the JWT `iss` claim exactly.

archived_at.description: If set, all rules referencing this issuer reject token exchange.
archived_at.title: Archived At

archived_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this issuer.
archived_by_actor_id.title: Archived By Actor Id

check_jti.description: Whether the jwt-bearer exchange enforces JTI single-use (replay protection) for tokens from this issuer. Applies only to assertions carrying a `jti` claim; tokens without one are accepted without single-use enforcement.
check_jti.title: Check Jti

created_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this issuer.
created_by_actor_id.title: Created By Actor Id

id.description: Tagged ID of the federation issuer.
id.title: Id

issuer_url.description: The `iss` claim value. Incoming JWTs must match exactly.
issuer_url.title: Issuer Url

jwks.description: How signing keys are obtained for signature verification.
jwks.title: Jwks

jwks_polling_disabled_at.description: If set, Anthropic's JWKS poller has paused polling for this issuer after repeated fetch failures. Re-enable by sending `jwks_polling_disabled: false` via the issuer update endpoint (POST) once the upstream JWKS endpoint is fixed. An OAuth caller cannot send this when the issuer backs a rule with any scope other than `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; use a Console session.
jwks_polling_disabled_at.title: Jwks Polling Disabled At

max_jwt_lifetime_seconds.description: Maximum allowed iat→exp spread for assertions from this issuer (1-176400 seconds, i.e. up to 49h). Assertions must carry both `iat` and `exp`; a missing `iat` is rejected.
max_jwt_lifetime_seconds.title: Max Jwt Lifetime Seconds

poll_status.description: Live state of Anthropic's JWKS polling for this issuer. Populated on both single-issuer retrieval and list responses, including archived issuers. Typically null for inline-key issuers (no polling), or when poll status is temporarily unavailable or polling has not started yet.

updated_at.description: When this issuer was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

updated_by_actor_id.description: Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this issuer.
updated_by_actor_id.title: Updated By Actor Id

BetaFederationIssuer.title: FederationIssuer

BetaJwksDiscovery.description: JWKS via the issuer's OIDC discovery document.

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional custom CA (PEM) for TLS verification of the JWKS fetch.
ca_cert_pem.title: Ca Cert Pem

discovery_base.description: Set when the discovery URL differs from `issuer_url`.
discovery_base.title: Discovery Base

BetaJwksDiscovery.title: JwksDiscovery

BetaJwksExplicitUrl.description: JWKS fetched from a fixed endpoint.

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional custom CA (PEM) for TLS verification of the JWKS fetch.
ca_cert_pem.title: Ca Cert Pem

BetaJwksExplicitUrl.title: JwksExplicitUrl

BetaJwksInline.description: JWKS supplied directly; no network fetch.
BetaJwksInline.title: JwksInline

BetaIssuerPollStatus.description:
Status of automatic JWKS polling for a federation issuer.

Anthropic periodically fetches the issuer's signing keys in the
background. These fields summarize the most recent fetches so the
health of the JWKS endpoint can be monitored.

consecutive_failures.description: Consecutive fetch failures since the last success.
consecutive_failures.title: Consecutive Failures

last_fetched_at.description: When the last successful fetch completed.
last_fetched_at.title: Last Fetched At

next_poll_at.description: When the next fetch is scheduled. Null if paused.
next_poll_at.title: Next Poll At

BetaIssuerPollStatus.title: IssuerPollStatus
